name: eel spawning

VINIT.justification: void state before any oceanic journey or reproduction is named

TANCH.justification: closed oceanic boundary containing the entire spawning system

AFWD.justification: directed forward transformation toward spawning grounds

AREV.justification: reverse descent transformation of offspring toward continental waters

CLINK.justification: composition linking migration to spawning to larval drift

IMSCRIB.justification: eel recognizes its own genetic and instinctual identity across generations

FSPLIT.justification: one adult stock branches into male and female gamete release paths

FFUSE.justification: male and female gametes reconstitute a single viable zygote cohort

EVALF.justification: negative branch of gamete or larval mortality

ENGAGR.justification: paradice of parental demise coinciding with offspring genesis, held unresolved

IFIX.justification: permanent append-only imprint of successful spawning cohort in population genetics

phase_3.void_description: pre-migratory continental eel with no oceanic vector assigned
phase_3.true_description: viable leptocephalus cohort reaching growth habitat
phase_3.false_description: total reproductive failure from predation or current misalignment
phase_3.both_description: parental death and zygote formation occurring as one indivisible oceanic event

steps.domain_action: unmigrated silver eel exists only as potential in freshwater
hormonal trigger initiates downstream river migration
river transit composes with coastal ocean entry
sustained swimming carries eels across Atlantic basin
Sargasso Sea gyre encloses arriving adults
eels recognize conspecifics by pheromone signature
spawning aggregation divides stock into male and female release paths
synchronized gamete clouds achieve positive fertilization
predation removes fraction of gametes before fusion
male and female gametes reconstitute single fertilized egg mass
adults expire while eggs are simultaneously released and fertilized
hatched leptocephali begin passive westward drift
drift composes with gradual metamorphosis into glass eels
glass eels ascend rivers to complete continental recolonization
successful cohort imprints permanent genetic record in population

phase_5.compiler_frontend: instinctual hormonal cascade translating photoperiod and temperature into migratory commands
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: chemical pheromone gradients exchanged between individuals during aggregation
phase_5.memory_mechanism: genetic and epigenetic encoding of route and timing across generations
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: lunar cycle and seasonal temperature thresholds ordering departure and arrival
phase_5.alfs_store: Sargasso Sea gyre as canonical bootstrap reference for all spawning events

phase_6.pre_cycle_state: mature silver eel stock with full somatic energy stores
phase_6.post_cycle_state: fertilized egg mass plus exhausted adult carcasses
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — energy and genetic information are exactly conserved across the split-fuse cycle
